ticket.summary: Sewage backing up through bathtub drain with toilet gurgling on kitchen sink use at 9 Delmore St — likely main line blockage, on-call plumber paged.
mitigation_advice: Stop using all water in the house — no flushing, sinks, laundry or dishwasher [PB-05]
Keep people and pets away from the tub and standing sewage; do not touch it [PB-05]
ticket.customer_message: Paging the on-call plumber now for 9 Delmore St — dispatch is typically within 60–90 minutes after hours, and he'll text you directly with his ETA. There's a $150 after-hours emergency dispatch fee; any repair work gets quoted once he's assessed the line on site. Until he arrives: no water use at all, and stay clear of the tub area [PB-05]. If sewage starts spreading beyond the bathroom, get everyone out of that area and call us back.
